Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 60, English)
The Foundation Course Roadmap: Fr om the 12 Golas to Chakra-Opening to Pr ofessionSpecific Advanced Siddhis

Structural note: this session is a solo, dir ect-addr ess intr oductory/r oadmap video — a structur ed overview of the Foundation Course's stages with no live sangat back-and-forth, named participant questions, or cr owd interaction. Per the standing template, this is ther efor e a 2-part document (Knowledge Base + Q&A Pairs only); Part III (Curated Conversational Q&A) is intentionally omitted for this session.

1. Purpose of this video. This session provides an overall roadmap for how a practitioner (an "aspirant") progresses to become a yogi, and how the Foundation Course specifically supports that progression — covering the stages involved, the approximate time each takes, and the general procedure, ahead of later videos that will teach each step in full detail.

2. Why the r oadmap comes first. Per this teaching, just as any game or task requires knowing its rules before playing, this introductory video is meant to help every Foundation Course member understand in advance what will happen to their physical and astral body throughout the course.
3. The Foundation Course's basis. Per this teaching, the entire Foundation Course structure has been built strictly according to the direct order of Guru Shri Hanuman Ji Maharaj.
4. Step one: r eceiving a mantra. The first step for any sadhak is receiving a specific mantra to begin jaap.

5. Choice of mantra. Per this teaching, a sadhak may use Ashaeiynn's given mantra, or , if they prefer , one of two alternative mantras — though using Ashaeiynn's own specific mantra is guaranteed to produce a definite and powerful benefit.

6. What happens physically when jaap begins. Per this teaching, as jaap begins, the mantra's ef fect circulates rapidly around the body , gradually forming an ener getic environment around it, before eventually settling into the body itself.
7. This settling begins filling the body's "golas." Per this teaching, once the mantra's ener gy settles into the body , the body's "golas" (ener gy circles/markers) begin to fill.
8. The body's cor e energetic structur e: 12 golas and 7 chakras. Per this teaching, the body's core ener getic structure consists mainly of 12 golas and 7 chakras.
9. What the golas actually ar e. Per this teaching, the golas function as the aura's protective shielding for the astral body , forming in sequence from the first through the twelfth.

10. Three main shields form during this pr ocess. Per this teaching, as the golas fill, three main protective shields form: the first at the 3rd gola, the second at the 8th gola, and the third (called the "protection layer") at the 12th gola.

1 1. What full completion of the 12 golas achieves. Per this teaching, once all 12 golas are completed, the body becomes fully "locked" — at which point no negative entity , ghost/spirit attack, or evil eye can af fect the practitioner .

12. The predator analogy . Per this teaching, just as predators tar get the weak rather than the strong, this shielding makes any negative or "upper" power think many times before attempting to af fect a fully-locked practitioner .
13. Timeframe for completing the 12 golas. Per this teaching, this process typically spans 40 to 45 days, with full procedural detail reserved for a future video.

14. What happens during this span. Per this teaching, throughout this period the practitioner performs jaap and tapasya, while Ashaeiynn's own shaktis and devta shaktis actively assist and protect them.

15. The closing hawan for the 12 golas. Per this teaching, this stage ends with a hawan that locks any remaining incomplete golas and adds Ashaeiynn's own additional shielding around the practitioner .

16. Experiential effects during the 12-gola pr ocess. Per this teaching, during this period the astral body becomes fully active — practitioners may experience darshans (visions), including in dreams, along with either significant ener gy loss or , alternately , excess ener gy that can lead to night-fall (a commonly asked-about experience).
17. Further experiential effects. Per this teaching, sleep may reduce, and practitioners may increasingly feel vibrations, full-body relaxation during mantra jaap, and goosebumps.

18. Drishti sometimes opens during the 12-gola hawan itself. Per this teaching, for some practitioners, drishti (subtle sight) opens specifically during the 12-gola-completion hawan, at the exact moment devtas descend during the ritual; for others, drishti doesn't open until the later chakra-opening stage.

19. Why drishti opening early doesn't mean further practice is unnecessary . Per this teaching, drishti without accompanying power/strength is not useful on its own — someone with sight but no strength becomes helpless and lacking support, so continued practice remains necessary regardless of when drishti opens.

20. The second stage: chakra-opening. Per this teaching, after completing the 12 golas, the next stage is the chakra-opening process, which typically takes around 7 weeks (varying somewhat based on the individual's own grahan shakti, or receptive capacity).

21. Why r egular check-ins matter . Per this teaching, Foundation Course members are asked to stay personally connected with Ashaeiynn and get their status checked weekly or every 1 1 days, so Ashaeiynn can determine exactly how much additional practice or grahan-shakti-building each individual needs.

22. Comparing timelines with and without Ashaeiynn's help. Per this teaching, completing the gola-filling stage independently (without Ashaeiynn), even for someone practicing 3-4 hours daily , would take 3-4 months; with Ashaeiynn's structure, this compresses to about 40 days.

23. The chakra-opening stage's comparative timeline. Per this teaching, completing chakra-opening independently would typically take 6-8 months, or even a full year; with Ashaeiynn's structure, this compresses to a maximum of about 7 weeks.

24. Weekly structur e of the chakra-opening pr ocess. Per this teaching, during these 7 weeks, one hawan is performed each week, and one chakra is opened each week, with corresponding sadhna/jaap/tapasya instructions given to the practitioner on a weekly basis.

25. The mechanism behind chakra-opening. Per this teaching, dhyan (meditation) and mantra-jaap shakti are combined, powered specifically by mantra shakti originating from the paramatma-ansha lok — it is this divine vibration itself that actually opens the chakras.

26. The result: self-independence. Per this teaching, a practitioner who fully completes all 7 weeks becomes self-independent and no longer needs to remain dependent on or return to Ashaeiynn, having earned this attainment through their own deity's grace, achieved under Ashaeiynn's guidance and supervision.

27. A serious caution: chakra-opening amplifies existing traits, it doesn't cr eate new ones. Per this teaching, opening the chakras does not grant new qualities — it multiplies whatever qualities a person already has roughly 100-fold: if a person has lust, it becomes 100 times stronger; if greed, 100 times stronger; if wisdom, 100 times greater; if devotion, 100 times deeper .

28. Why this makes a practitioner's words carry far mor e weight. Per this teaching, at this stage, anything a practitioner speaks — including blessings or curses — carries dramatically more consequence and weight than before.

29. An explicit r equest for self-contr ol during this stage. Per this teaching, practitioners are specifically asked to control their speech and temperament throughout the chakra-opening process, since careless words at this stage could genuinely harm someone else.

30. A strict warning about misuse of these powers. Per this teaching, if a practitioner ever tries to misuse these powers, deliberately harm someone, or apply them wrongly , Hanuman Ji Maharaj's strict order is that all such powers will be forcibly withdrawn back to his own feet — and even the practitioner's own bhakti-tattva (devotional element) will be permanently locked, with no one able to free it afterward.

31. Addressing the obvious concern: won't some people misuse this power? Per this teaching, Bhaiya directly addresses this frequently-asked concern: anyone who misuses this power will be judged directly by Hanuman Ji Maharaj himself, and having one's bhakti-tattva locked this way ef fectively means becoming permanently unable to practice devotion for the remainder of that lifetime.

32. A reassuring, positive counterpart: powers multiply when used for good. Per this teaching, acting for someone else's benefit multiplies these powers a thousandfold; acting specifically for someone's upliftment or liberation can multiply them up to a hundredthousand-fold; and acting purely for one's own benefit is entirely fine too — the only firm rule is to cause no harm and commit no unrighteous act.

33. What full chakra-opening achieves. Per this teaching, once this stage is complete, all seven chakras become activated; specifically , four layers of each chakra are opened during this hawan process, enabling kundalini shakti to comfortably reach the fifth Dimension.

34. Continued practice raises the Dimension further . Per this teaching, continued jaap after this point causes kundalini shakti to rise further still, crossing additional Dimensions — directly building on the Dimension concept taught previously .
35. A choice point: stop her e, or continue to the Advanced Stage. Per this teaching, a practitioner may choose to stop at this point, or continue onward to the Advanced Stage.
36. Recap of the stage structur e so far . Per this teaching, the 12 golas constitute the Fundamental Stage, chakra-opening constitutes the Intermediate Stage, and what follows is the Advanced Stage.

37. What the Advanced Stage covers. Per this teaching, the Advanced Stage teaches practitioners to use their drishti and powers at a much higher , professional level — specifically tailored to each practitioner's own profession or field of work.

38. Advanced Stage example: scientists. Per this teaching, a scientist who has attained drishti will, with the help of Ashaeiynn's shaktis and various astral-world insights, be shown things that let them discover something genuinely new — solutions arriving to them readily , without needing to labor consciously to find them.

39. Advanced Stage example: doctors. Per this teaching, a doctor using this drishti can see precisely which vein or internal issue is causing a patient's problem, enabling much more precise diagnosis and treatment.

40. Advanced Stage example: ar chitects. Per this teaching, an architect can draw directly from the sookshma jagat (subtle world) via this drishti to create new designs and models applicable in the sthool jagat (physical world).

41. Advanced Stage example: memory-power needs, athletes, and soldiers. Per this teaching, someone needing greater memory power receives field-specific siddhis that directly boost it; athletes/sportspeople receive siddhis granting "ojaswi/tejaswi" (radiant, vigorous) qualities drawn from Hanuman Ji Maharaj's own shakti; and soldiers receive siddhis enabling remote monitoring of an enemy
— allowing them to mentally "travel" into the subtle world from a place of safety to observe danger , strictly for righteous, protective purposes.

42. The overall mission behind this r oadmap. Per this teaching, the goal is to prevent spirituality from being treated as a separate, disconnected concept — instead integrating it directly and systematically into a practitioner's ordinary life and profession, in a way that can multiply their real-world work and output a thousandfold.

43. A historical framing. Per this teaching, kings and rulers in ancient times routinely used these same kinds of powers, though modern society has lar gely for gotten this — Ashaeiynn/Foundation Course members will come to recognize, identify , and genuinely experience these same ener gies and siddhis once their chakras are opened.
QUICK RULES SUMMARY

The Foundation Course has three sequential stages: the Fundamental Stage (completing 12 golas, ~40-45 days), the Intermediate Stage (chakra-opening, ~7 weeks), and the Advanced Stage (profession-specific application of drishti and siddhis) — all built strictly per Hanuman Ji Maharaj's direct order . The 12 golas form the astral body's protective shielding, with three main shields forming at the 3rd, 8th, and 12th gola; full completion fully "locks" the body against negative entities, ghost/spirit attacks, or evil eye. Common experiential ef fects during the 12-gola process include darshans (including in dreams), vibrations, reduced sleep, goosebumps, possible ener gy loss or excess ener gy (sometimes causing night-fall), and — for some practitioners — drishti opening during the closing hawan itself; drishti without accompanying strength/power is not suf ficient on its own. Ashaeiynn's structure compresses timelines dramatically: gola-filling that would take 3-4 months independently takes ~40 days; chakra-opening that would take 6-8 months or a year independently takes a maximum of ~7 weeks — with one hawan and one chakra opened per week during that stage. Completing all 7 weeks of chakra-opening confers self-independence — a practitioner no longer needs to remain dependent on Ashaeiynn afterward, having earned the attainment through their own deity's grace under Ashaeiynn's guidance. Chakra-opening does not create new qualities — it amplifies existing ones roughly 100-fold (lust, greed, wisdom, devotion, whatever a person already has), which is why a practitioner's spoken words (including blessings or curses) carry dramatically more weight at this stage, requiring careful self-control of speech and temperament. Misusing these powers to deliberately harm someone triggers Hanuman Ji Maharaj's strict order: all such powers are forcibly withdrawn, and the practitioner's own bhakti-tattva is permanently locked for the remainder of that lifetime, judged directly by Hanuman Ji Maharaj himself; conversely , using these powers for others' benefit multiplies them a thousandfold, and for someone's upliftment/liberation up to a hundred-thousand-fold — the only firm rule is to cause no harm and commit no unrighteous act. Completing chakra-opening activates all seven chakras (four layers of each chakra opened via hawan), enabling kundalini shakti to comfortably reach the fifth Dimension, with continued jaap raising the Dimension further still. The Advanced Stage tailors drishti and siddhis to a practitioner's own profession — illustrated with scientists (new discoveries/insights), doctors (precise internal diagnosis), architects (subtle-world-derived designs), memory-power seekers, athletes (radiant/vigorous "ojaswi-tejaswi" qualities), and soldiers (remote, protective monitoring of danger) — all in service of integrating spirituality directly into ordinary professional life rather than treating it as separate. User-style questions with answers gr ounded in this Ashaeiynn training session. Gr eeting style: "Jai Siyaram." Note: this session is a solo training/r oadmap video with no live sangat interaction, so ther e is no Part III (Curated Conversational Q&A) for this session — only Parts I and II.

Q1. What is the purpose of this particular session? A: To provide an overall roadmap of how a practitioner progresses from aspirant to yogi through the Foundation Course, including the stages involved, approximate timeframes, and general procedure.
Q2. What is the very first step for a sadhak in this course? A: Receiving a specific mantra to begin jaap.

Q3. Must a sadhak use exactly the mantra Ashaeiynn pr ovides? A: Not necessarily — per this teaching, a sadhak may use one of two alternative mantras if they prefer , though using Ashaeiynn's own specific mantra is guaranteed to produce a definite and powerful benefit.

Q4. What happens physically when a practitioner begins jaap? A: Per this teaching, the mantra's ef fect circulates rapidly around the body , forms an ener getic environment, and then gradually settles into the body itself, causing the body's "golas" to begin filling.
Q5. What ar e the body's cor e energetic structur es, per this teaching? A: Mainly 12 golas and 7 chakras.

Q6. What function do the 12 golas actually serve? A: Per this teaching, they function as the astral body's protective shielding, forming in sequence and creating three main shields — at the 3rd, 8th, and 12th gola.

Q7. What happens once all 12 golas ar e fully completed? A: Per this teaching, the body becomes fully "locked," at which point no negative entity , ghost/spirit attack, or evil eye can af fect the practitioner .
Q8. Roughly how long does completing the 12 golas take? A: Per this teaching, typically 40 to 45 days.

Q9. What r ole does Ashaeiynn play during this 40-45 day period? A: Per this teaching, Ashaeiynn's own shaktis and devta shaktis actively assist and protect the practitioner throughout, culminating in a closing hawan that locks any remaining golas and adds further shielding.

Q10. What kinds of experiences ar e common during the 12-gola pr ocess? A: Per this teaching, darshans (including in dreams), vibrations, reduced sleep, goosebumps, full-body relaxation during jaap, and possibly significant ener gy loss or excess ener gy (sometimes leading to night-fall).

Q1 1. Does drishti (subtle sight) always open at the same point for everyone? A: No — per this teaching, for some practitioners drishti opens during the 12-gola completion hawan itself, while for others it opens later , during the chakra-opening stage.

Q12. If drishti opens early , does that mean further practice isn't necessary? A: No — per this teaching, drishti without accompanying power/strength isn't useful on its own; a person with sight but no strength becomes helpless, so continued practice remains necessary regardless of when drishti opens.
Q13. What is the second major stage after the 12 golas? A: Per this teaching, the chakra-opening process, typically taking around 7 weeks (varying based on individual grahan shakti).

Q14. Why ar e Foundation Course members asked to check in weekly or every 1 1 days? A: Per this teaching, so Ashaeiynn can determine exactly how much additional practice or grahan-shakti-building each individual specifically needs.

Q15. How much faster is Ashaeiynn's structur ed process compar ed to independent practice? A: Per this teaching, gola-filling that would take 3-4 months independently compresses to about 40 days, and chakra-opening that would take 6-8 months or a year independently compresses to a maximum of about 7 weeks.

Q16. What happens on a weekly basis during the chakra-opening stage? A: Per this teaching, one hawan is performed and one chakra is opened each week, with corresponding sadhna/jaap/tapasya instructions given weekly .

Q17. What mechanism actually opens the chakras, per this teaching? A: Dhyan combined with mantra-jaap shakti, powered by mantra shakti originating from the paramatma-ansha lok — this divine vibration itself performs the opening.

Q18. What is achieved once a practitioner completes all 7 weeks of chakra-opening? A: Per this teaching, self-independence — the practitioner no longer needs to remain dependent on or return to Ashaeiynn, having earned this attainment through their own deity's grace under Ashaeiynn's guidance.

Q19. Does chakra-opening grant entir ely new personal qualities? A: No — per this teaching, it amplifies whatever qualities a person already has roughly 100-fold, whether that's lust, greed, wisdom, or devotion.

Q20. Why does this make car eful speech especially important during chakra-opening? A: Per this teaching, because at this stage, anything a practitioner speaks — including blessings or curses — carries dramatically more weight and consequence than before.

Q21. What happens if a practitioner deliberately misuses these powers to harm someone? A: Per this teaching, Hanuman Ji Maharaj's strict order withdraws all such powers back to his own feet, and the practitioner's own bhakti-tattva is permanently locked for the remainder of that lifetime, with the practitioner judged directly by Hanuman Ji Maharaj himself.

Q22. Isn't ther e a risk that people r eceiving this much power will misuse it? A: Per this teaching, anyone who misuses it will be judged directly by Hanuman Ji Maharaj, and the consequence (a permanently locked bhakti-tattva) is severe enough that this risk is directly and seriously addressed within the teaching itself.

Q23. Does using these powers for someone else's benefit have any special effect? A: Yes — per this teaching, acting for someone else's benefit multiplies these powers a thousandfold, and acting specifically for someone's upliftment or liberation can multiply them up to a hundred-thousand-fold.

Q24. Is it acceptable to use these powers pur ely for one's own benefit? A: Yes — per this teaching, that's entirely fine; the only firm rule is to cause no harm to others and commit no unrighteous act.

Q25. What does completing the full chakra-opening stage achieve r egarding the chakras themselves? A: Per this teaching, all seven chakras become activated, with four layers of each chakra opened during this hawan process, enabling kundalini shakti to comfortably reach the fifth Dimension.

Q26. What ar e the three overall stages of the Foundation Course path, in order? A: Per this teaching, the Fundamental Stage (12 golas), the Intermediate Stage (chakra-opening), and the Advanced Stage (profession-specific application).

Q27. What does the Advanced Stage actually teach a practitioner to do? A: Per this teaching, to use their drishti and powers at a much higher , professional level specifically tailored to their own profession or field of work.

Q28. Can you give examples of how the Advanced Stage applies differ ently acr oss pr ofessions? A: Per this teaching, examples include scientists gaining insight for new discoveries, doctors gaining precise internal diagnostic sight, architects drawing designs from the subtle world, athletes gaining radiant "ojaswi-tejaswi" qualities, and soldiers gaining remote, protective monitoring abilities regarding danger .

Q29. What is the overall mission behind structuring the path this way? A: Per this teaching, to prevent spirituality from being treated as a separate, disconnected concept, and instead integrate it directly and systematically into a practitioner's ordinary life and profession, multiplying their real-world output significantly .

Q30. Is this use of spiritual power for worldly/pr ofessional benefit a new idea, per this teaching? A: No — per this teaching, kings and rulers in ancient times routinely used these same kinds of powers; modern society has lar gely for gotten this, and Foundation Course members will come to recognize and genuinely experience these same ener gies once their chakras are opened.
